Osk.title.note: On-screen keyboard (over the machine's screen): the words in its bar, which moves it.

Osk.close.note: On-screen keyboard: tooltip and screen-reader name of the × button in its bar.

Osk.resize.message: Drag sideways to resize the keyboard.
Osk.resize.note: On-screen keyboard: tooltip of the ↔ handle in its bar, left of the close button.

Osk.key.Escape.note: On-screen keyboard: the Escape key's label, as a US keyboard labels it.

Osk.key.Tab.note: On-screen keyboard: the Tab key's label.

Osk.key.CapsLock.note: On-screen keyboard: the Caps Lock key's label.

Osk.key.Shift.note: On-screen keyboard: the label of both Shift keys.

Osk.key.Control.note: On-screen keyboard: the label of both Control keys.

Osk.key.Meta.note: On-screen keyboard: the label of both Windows (Super, Meta) keys, beside Ctrl and Alt.

Osk.key.Alt.note: On-screen keyboard: the left Alt key's label.

Osk.key.AltGr.note: On-screen keyboard: the right Alt key's label (AltGr on layouts that use it for a third character).

Osk.key.ContextMenu.note: On-screen keyboard: the label of the context menu key, between the right Super and Ctrl keys.

Osk.key.Backspace.note: On-screen keyboard: the Backspace key's label.

Osk.key.Enter.note: On-screen keyboard: the label of the Enter key and the keypad's Enter key.

Osk.key.PrintScreen.note: On-screen keyboard: the Print Screen key's label, right of F12.

Osk.key.ScrollLock.note: On-screen keyboard: the Scroll Lock key's label.

Osk.key.Pause.note: On-screen keyboard: the Pause (Break) key's label.

Osk.key.Insert.note: On-screen keyboard: the Insert key's label.

Osk.key.Home.note: On-screen keyboard: the Home key's label.

Osk.key.PageUp.note: On-screen keyboard: the Page Up key's label.

Osk.key.Delete.note: On-screen keyboard: the Delete key's label.

Osk.key.End.note: On-screen keyboard: the End key's label.

Osk.key.PageDown.note: On-screen keyboard: the Page Down key's label.

Osk.key.NumLock.note: On-screen keyboard: the Num Lock key's label, at the top left of the numeric keypad.

Osk.key.ArrowUp.note: On-screen keyboard: the Up arrow key's label (a symbol).

Osk.key.ArrowDown.note: On-screen keyboard: the Down arrow key's label (a symbol).

Osk.key.ArrowLeft.note: On-screen keyboard: the Left arrow key's label (a symbol).

Osk.key.ArrowRight.note: On-screen keyboard: the Right arrow key's label (a symbol).
